svg.title: Poster study: astronauts walk out to the rocket
svg.desc: Graphic poster illustration: three astronauts in white suits and helmets stride along a causeway toward a tall rocket and its orange launch tower, one waving, each carrying a small suit-cooling case; family and crew behind a barrier cheer and hold up phones; a huge setting sun glows in a banded orange and violet sky. Fictional scenario for a style study.
